# GitHubDHC

GitHubDHC ports the GitHub Dark High Contrast appearance to Obsidian using official Primer colors and GitHub-style callouts. The recorded description enables both Dark High Contrast and Light Default modes and restyles interface components, form elements and typography to match the GitHub visual language, while the theme index records dark mode only.

![GitHubDHC screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scottkirvan/GitHubDHC/HEAD/imgs/thumbnail.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "GitHubDHC"
    author: "Scott Kirvan"
    repo:   "scottkirvan/GitHubDHC"
    slug:   "githubdhc"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/githubdhc"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/scottkirvan/GitHubDHC"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scottkirvan/GitHubDHC/HEAD/imgs/thumbnail.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply GitHub's Dark High Contrast appearance to Obsidian with official Primer colors and GitHub-style callouts. Enable both Dark High Contrast and Light Default modes and restyle UI components, form elements, and typography to match GitHub's visual language."
}
```
